claims.statement: For x=8 and y=8, the equation reduces to 1/z + 1/w = 1/2 - 1/8 - 1/8 = 1/4, so R = 1/4 exactly.
For x=8, y=8, the z-interval formula max(8, floor(1/R)+1) <= z <= floor(2/R) yields max(8,5) <= z <= 8, i.e. 8 <= z <= 8, so the only z to test is z=8.
For z=8 with R=1/4, w = z/(R*z - 1) = 8/(8/4 - 1) = 8/1 = 8, which is a positive integer.
